thread:
ravi: short sync: are we converging on one hosting manifest with env_overrides or separate manifests per hosting mode? trying to avoid the last mess where private fields silently failed.
emily: favor single manifest + env_overrides + an extensions map. core surface stays small.
jordan: agree. must add a lightweight runtime probe so control plane can validate manifests at deploy time. probe returns capability_version, supported_quant, max_seq_len.
ravi: good. also we need manifest versioning (major.minor) and a compatibility policy. major = runtime upgrade required.
emily: add required_for metadata on fields, e.g., required_for=["dedicated"] and advisory_for=["hosted"]. makes validation deterministic.
jordan: secrets: reference only. secret_refs -> {type: managed|external, id: string}. no raw secrets in manifests.
ravi: Dedicated needs scheduler hints: capacity_hint and prewarm=true/false. hosted ignores but accepts.
emily: add cache_namespace hint to avoid KV cache collisions across tenants. field: cache.namespace and cache.scope=[global,tenant,model].
jordan: rollout_policy in manifest should include canary_pct and success_eval_id. control plane must run eval check to gate.
ravi: probe example for ops: {"capability_version":"1.0","supports":["fp16","int8","kv_cache_namespaces"],"max_seq_len":4096} — control plane rejects manifest fields not in supports.
ops-bot: probe-received: runtime-7 cap_ver=1.0 supports=[fp16,int8,kv_cache_namespaces] max_seq_len=4096.
emily: action items: ravi draft RFC with schema & versioning; jordan prototype probe endpoint; i'll add SDK lint + `redwood manifest lint` that calls control-plane lint.
ravi: i'll post RFC and tag reviewers. keep deprecation windows explicit (8 weeks) and require dry-run + telemetry gate for any breaking change.
